backfill_note: The post was drafted 2026-06-25. Its original harness was deleted after drafting per the firsthand-cleanup policy (small local disk). This run directory was reconstructed from the post's firsthand-benchmark.md and RE-EXECUTED fresh on 2026-08-07 against the same versions the post pins. The results here are newly measured, not copied from the draft.

environment.runner: Node.js + Vitest (jsdom, zoneless Angular TestBed) + tsc
environment.note: Deterministic logic/type benchmark. No timing is measured; CPU/GPU/RAM do not affect the result, so they are intentionally omitted. Type errors, signal re-run counts, and abort/complete sets are deterministic for a given library version.

subject.name: @angular/forms (Signal Forms) + @angular/core
subject.note: Signal Forms (@angular/forms/signals) reached stable in Angular 22.0. Pinned to 22.0.2 (the version the post cites), not 'latest'.

baseline.name: @angular/forms (Reactive Forms)
baseline.note: Same package/version. The comparison is Signal Forms vs the classic Reactive Forms API within the identical Angular build.

raw_artifacts.retention_policy: none — this benchmark produces no large raw artifacts
raw_artifacts.note: The only output is probe-result.json (deterministic: tsc error counts, signal re-run counts, and the abort/complete sets). It is committed in full. node_modules is not committed; run.sh reinstalls the pinned versions.
